manual.title: Thumbs in the web client need File Transformation.
manual.install: Add the repository https://www.iamparadox.dev/jellyfin/plugins/manifest.json (Dashboard → Plugins → Repositories), install File Transformation from the catalog and restart Jellyfin. See its README.
manual.alternative: Alternatively, paste this tag in Dashboard → General → Custom HTML (branding) or in JavaScript Injector:
manual.baseUrl: If Jellyfin runs under a base URL, prefix it (e.g. /jellyfin/RatingsRecs/Web/ratings.js). After any change reload the web page with Ctrl+F5.
level.name: {0} - name
favoriteFromOtherClients: The heart set in other clients (TV apps) counts as a rating
seriesMode.hint: Ratings are never deleted when the mode changes.
creditsWarning: {0}% of the seasons ({1}/{2}) have no per-episode credits: with poor metadata the per-season mode works almost like "whole series". Refresh the TV metadata from TMDb or TVDb first.
usersCanChooseMode: Users can choose their own mode ("For you" page)
implicitFavorite: Implicit value: Favourite from other clients
homeRows.Auto: Auto (Home Screen Sections if available, otherwise the script)
homeRows.hint: With Home Screen Sections each user adds "Recommended for you" and "Rate these" from the Modular Home settings (Home Screen Sections must be enabled in its own settings). Restart Jellyfin after changing this option.
showSimilarRow: "Similar, picked for you" row on detail pages
provider.title: Jellyfin 12: native "More like this"
provider.hint: Libraries where the native "More like this" lists (web, TV and mobile apps) are ranked with each user's taste. On save the plugin puts its provider first in the similar item provider order of the selected libraries and removes it from the others (Dashboard → Libraries). Untick everything and save before uninstalling the plugin.
override.title: Jellyfin 10.11: suggestions
override.label: Replace Jellyfin's suggestions with the recommendations (/Items/Suggestions, /Movies/Recommendations)
override.hint: Off by default. It also reaches the apps that use these lists, but it depends on Jellyfin internals: if it fails it switches itself off and the status above says so.
excludeHatedCollections: Exclude the other chapters of a saga rated -3
engine.hint: Changes apply at the next computation (Recompute now, or within 6 hours).
